question: The first National Games known as the Indian Olympic Games were hosted before independence in the year _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**1924**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first National Games, also known as the Indian Olympic Games,** were held in 1924 in Lahore, then part of undivided India. 
 
• The** National Games are a multi-sport event that aims to identify and promote talent at the grassroots level.**
 
• The **games are held every two years**, rotating between different states.
 
• The **main purpose of the National Games is to identify talent from across the country who could bring laurels at the Olympics. **
 
• The National Games were originally known as the Indian Olympic Games until 1940, when they were renamed the National Games.
 
• The 1940 National Games were hosted in Mumbai.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• India first participated in the Olympic Games in 1900.__
 
• The International Olympic Committee is a governing body of the Olympics.
 
• The first modern Olympics were held in 1896 in Athens, Greece.
 
• Norman Pritchard represented India at the 1900 Olympics, making it the nation’s first Olympic appearance. India sent its first contingent at the 1920 Olympics.
 
• India first sent a team to the Summer Olympic Games in 1920.
 
• India won its first gold medal in Hockey at Amsterdam Olympics 1928 and until 1956 Indian men's Hockey team remained unbeaten in Olympics.
 
• India’s last gold medal in Hockey was in the year 1980 Moscow Olympics.
 
• In the 1952 Summer Olympics wrestler K.D. Jadhav won the first individual medal for independent India.
 
• Milkha Singh is the first Indian athlete to reach the Olympic finals in Athletics.
